scene halloweenfourmingletwo1
And into another.
lines.zh: 接着又进入下一场。

lines.en: Just in a more serious way.
lines.zh: 只是这一次更严肃一些。

lines.en: : Hey, you...
: You walked right past me before...
lines.zh: : 你刚才直接从我身边走过去了……

lines.en: : Are we, like...you know...good?
lines.zh: : 我们之间，那个……你懂的……还算没事吧？

lines.en: : Oh, hey. Yeah. We’re good.
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿。嗯。我们没事。

lines.en: : Then why-
lines.zh: : 那为什么-

lines.en: : I probably just didn’t see you.
lines.zh: : 我大概只是没看见你。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo2
: Come on, Senpai. You really expect me to believe that? You and me are like the most noticeable people around here for miles. You’ve gotta level with me.
lines.zh: : 拜托，Senpai。你真以为我会信吗？在方圆几英里内，你和我大概是最显眼的两个人了。你得跟我说实话。

lines.en: : I get that I may have made things kind of weird with the...sudden confession and...subsequent invitation to have NSA friend sex with me, but I’m good now. I get it. And I’ll stop bothering you like that.
lines.zh: : 我知道，那次……突然表白，还有……之后邀请你跟我来一场不谈感情的友情性爱，大概把事情弄得很怪。但我现在没事了。我懂了。我不会再那样缠着你了。

lines.en: : I just don’t want shit to get all weird with us when we see each other every single day and it’s like you’ve barely even looked at me lately.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让我们之间变得那么别扭——我们天天都要见面，可你最近几乎连看都不看我一眼。

lines.en: : None of that’s on you, Imani. I’m pretty sure my brain is just broken. But, just so you know, I’m not trying to avoid you or anything.
lines.zh: : 这都不怪你，Imani。我很确定是我的脑子坏了。不过你放心，我没有在躲你之类的。

lines.en: : Promise?
lines.zh: : 你保证？

lines.en: : I try not to promise anything unless I’m absolutely desperate or just literally incapable of doing so for reasons that are hard to describe. But I can seriously assure you that I mean business.
lines.zh: : 我尽量不轻易许诺——除非我实在走投无路，或者因为某些难以启齿的原因根本做不到。但我可以很认真地保证，我说的是正经事。

lines.en: : Me too. That’s why I’m wearing this suit. But some business is best conducted {i}away{/i} from a group of teenagers in cosplay. You know what I’m saying?
lines.zh: : 我也是。所以我才穿了这身西装。不过有些正事，最好还是{i}离{/i}一群玩角色扮演的青少年远一点再办。你懂我意思吧？

lines.en: : That you...want to hold a conference?
lines.zh: : 你是说……你想开个会？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo3
: That I want to go back to before I made shit weird and just be normal friends again. We can make that work, can’t we?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我想回到把事情弄糟之前，重新做回普通朋友。这总能做到吧？

lines.en: : Not so long as you’ve got that sort of expression on. The Imani I know would be too busy throwing jokes at me and calling everyone racist to look like that.
lines.zh: : 只要你脸上还是那副表情就做不到。我认识的 Imani 只会忙着朝我扔段子、见谁都说人家种族歧视，不会露出那种表情。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo4
: Oh my God! That’s it! You just don’t want to have friend sex with me because I’m black!
lines.zh: : 我的天啊！就是这样！你就是不想跟我搞友情炮，因为我是黑人！

lines.en: : I can assure you that’s not-
lines.zh: : 我可以向你保证不是-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo5
: I know. Just trying to...lighten the mood after dragging things down again.
lines.zh: : 我知道。只是想……在又把气氛搞沉了之后缓和一下。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. For the random apology. For putting you in a weird spot. For everything.
lines.zh: : 对不起。为这没头没脑的道歉。为把你推到尴尬的境地。为这一切。

lines.en: : Don’t be sorry. Just do all of my work for me for the rest of forever and we can close this case for good.
lines.zh: : 别道歉。只要你从今往后永远替我把活儿都干完，这事就算彻底了结了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo6
: So, in other words, keep doing exactly what I’ve been doing ever since I first showed up?
lines.zh: : 换句话说，就是继续做我从第一天出现起就一直在做的事？

lines.en: : Right. Just wear that outfit while you’re doing it from now on because it looks very good on you and it would be a shame if this were the only time I ever got to see it.
lines.zh: : 对。只是以后做的时候都穿这身，因为它真的很适合你，要是这辈子只能看一次就太可惜了。

lines.en: : That’s a really horny thing to say for a guy who doesn’t want to nail me.
lines.zh: : 对一个不想睡我的人来说，这话可真够饥渴的。

lines.en: : I already told you. It’s not that I {i}don’t want to.{/i} It’s-
lines.zh: : 我说过了。不是我{i}不想{/i}。只是-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo7

: Senpai, to salvage some of what’s left of my self-esteem, please just let me assume that this is some sort of biological thing and that you just can’t get it up for some reason. That way, we’ll both be happy.
lines.zh: : Senpai，为了挽救我仅剩的那点自尊，就让我假设这是什么生理上的问题、你只是因为某种原因硬不起来吧。这样我们俩都好过。

lines.en: : What? No we won’t. Don’t just give me erectile dysfunction to make yourself feel better.
lines.zh: : 什么？我们才不会好过。别为了让自己好受就给我扣个阳痿的帽子。

lines.en: : You should tell your idol girlfriend to get into acting. She’s really good at it based on all of those fake cries and moans from that night on the beach with your permanently flaccid penis.
lines.zh: : 你该让你那位偶像女友去当演员。从那天晚上在海滩上那些假哭假叫来看，她可真在行——配合你那根永久疲软的阴茎。

lines.en: : Imani, I don’t like this.
lines.zh: : Imani，我不喜欢这样。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo8
: Don’t worry, Senpai. Your secret’s safe with me. And hers too, of course. But that one’s only for legal purposes at this point.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Senpai。你的秘密在我这儿很安全。她的当然也是。不过那一条现在纯粹是出于法律上的考虑。

lines.en: : By any chance, is there a way for you to salvage your self-esteem {i}without{/i} making me impotent?
lines.zh: : 有没有可能，你挽回自尊的{i}同时{/i}别把我变成性无能？

lines.en: : No. I’m afraid there is not. This is the only thing that makes sense to me at this point in time.
lines.zh: : 没有。恐怕没有。在我现在的脑子里，只有这个解释说得通。

lines.en: : I’ll hang onto the outfit for your sake, though. You know, in case you’re able to get it up again one day.
lines.zh: : 不过看在你的份上，我会留着这身衣服的。你知道，万一哪天你又能硬起来了呢。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay. I’m going to go talk to someone else now..
lines.zh: : 好吧。我现在要去跟别人聊聊了。

lines.en: : Yeah! Run away from your problems, Senpai! That’s the way to do it!
lines.zh: : 对！逃避问题去吧，Senpai！就该这么干！

lines.en: : Just...maybe not in {i}that{/i} direction.
lines.zh: : 只是……{i}那个{/i}方向可能不行。

lines.en: : Why? What’s wrong with-
lines.zh: : 为什么？那边怎么了-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo9
: I understand now.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Have you been eating enough potassium?
lines.zh: : 你最近钾摄入够吗？

lines.en: : I’m not sure why the lower-third is trying to mask your name when I already know it’s you, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我早就知道是你了，Sana，不明白下方的字幕条为什么还要遮住你的名字。

lines.en: : The lower...what?
lines.zh: : 下方……什么？

lines.en: : So, what are you supposed to be this year?
lines.zh: : 那么，你今年扮的是什么？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Cool.
: I can’t tell if I’m terrified or turned on.
lines.zh: : 我分不清自己是被吓到了还是被撩到了。

lines.en: : Most assuredly the latter. She somehow looks even more appetizing than normal in this costume, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 当然是后者。她穿上这身，不知怎么比平时更秀色可餐了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Are we seeing the same thing right now?
lines.zh: : 我们看的真是同一样东西吗？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo10
: You’re lucky you’re...seeing anything at all...I can barely even...move in this costume...
lines.zh: : 你还算幸运……至少还看得见东西……我穿这身连……动都快动不了了……

lines.en: : Not to mention that...it’s kind of...burning up in here...
lines.zh: : 更别说……这里还……热得要命……

lines.en: : Have you considered maybe wearing a {i}normal{/i} costume for once to circumvent such an issue?
lines.zh: : 你就没想过穿一次{i}正常{/i}的衣服，来避免这种问题吗？

lines.en: : I feel weird...dressing up like everyone else...
lines.zh: : 我觉得……穿得跟别人一样很别扭……

lines.en: : At least like this I...can disguise myself as someone else and...not have to worry about...looking weird...
lines.zh: : 至少这样我……可以把自己伪装成另一个人……就不用……担心看起来很怪……

lines.en: : I think you should be worrying about that {i}at least{/i} a little bit, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你{i}至少{/i}该为这个担心一点点，Sana。

lines.en: : The...um...alternative was...letting Molly make me a costume, but...without Ayane doing that this year...I didn’t think I’d...you know...
lines.zh: : 那个……嗯……另一个选择是……让 Molly 帮我做一套，但……今年 Ayane 不做了……我就觉得我大概……你懂的……

lines.en: : What about a Maya costume then? Those seem to be “all the rage” this Halloween. Plus, her clothes would probably fit you.
lines.zh: : 那扮 Maya 呢？今年万圣节那身好像「红得发紫」。而且她的衣服你应该穿得下。

lines.en: : They...
lines.zh: : 穿得……

lines.en: : They do...
lines.zh: : 确实穿得下……

lines.en: : Ayane...made me wear them...
lines.zh: : Ayane……让我穿过……

lines.en: : And none of you thought to show me?
lines.zh: : 你们谁都没想过让我看看？

lines.en: : Is that...
lines.zh: : 那是……

lines.en: : Is that...something you’d...want to see?
lines.zh: : 那是你……想看的东西吗？

lines.en: : The Dorm Wars ended weeks ago, Sana. You don’t need to intentionally mislead me by alluding to such things anymore.
lines.zh: : 宿舍战争几周前就结束了，Sana。你不用再用这种暗示故意误导我了。

lines.en: : I...I’m only asking because I...
lines.zh: : 我……我只是想问问，因为我……

lines.en: : I still have...um...
lines.zh: : 我还留着……嗯……

lines.en: : Ayane had to buy...copies of all of the clothes since...Maya’s didn’t fit her and...she...she thought it would be fun to...buy her entire wardrobe for...me as well...
lines.zh: : 因为 Maya 的衣服她穿不下……Ayane 只好……把那些衣服全买了复制款……而且她……她觉得好玩……把整套衣柜也给我买了一份……

lines.en: : So you just...have Maya’s closet at your disposal to use whenever you want now?
lines.zh: : 所以现在……Maya 的衣柜你随时想用就能用？

lines.en: : Not...not because of my own choosing, but...y...yes...
lines.zh: : 不是……不是我自己选的，但……嗯……是的……

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : By any chance, did Ayane make you do anything else? Something you may need to notify the authorities about?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，Ayane 还让你做过别的什么吗？需要报警的那种？

lines.en: : Um...n...no...that’s...
lines.zh: : 嗯……不……没有……那倒……

lines.en: : I’ve never...with anyone...
lines.zh: : 我从来没……跟任何人……

lines.en: : Would you feel more comfortable having this discussion in my office where she wouldn’t be able to overhear it?
lines.zh: : 要不要去我办公室谈？那样她就听不到了，你会不会自在些？

lines.en: : She...she didn’t do anything! I was just...I thought...maybe you’d...like to...
lines.zh: : 她……她什么都没做！我只是……我以为……也许你会……喜欢……

lines.en: : You know...since you’re always...around Maya and...I...um...
lines.zh: : 你知道……因为你总是……待在 Maya 身边，而我……嗯……

lines.en: : Y...You know what?...Just...forget I said anything...I don’t...I don’t really know what...would even happen after I...uh...anyway...so...uhh...
lines.zh: : 那……算了？……就……当我什么都没说……我……我其实也不知道……之后会怎么样……嗯……总之……那个……呃……

lines.en: : Have you been...eating enough potassium lately?...
lines.zh: : 你最近……钾摄入够吗？……

lines.en: : I think this conversation is over, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这场对话到此为止吧，Sana。

lines.en: : Oh, thank god...I need to...um...go lay down...
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地……我得……嗯……去躺一会儿……

lines.en: scene black
Running out of girls to talk to, I begin to make my way across the room toward a group of characters that I, once again, do not recognize.
lines.zh: 能聊的女生快没了，我开始穿过房间，走向一群我依然认不出来的角色。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I have any idea what Sana is. But, at the same time, I’m quite confident she doesn’t either.
lines.zh: 这倒不是说我知道 Sana 扮的是什么。但同时，我很确信她自己也不知道。

lines.en: But what’s perhaps even stranger than the way she’s dressed is how she’s been acting lately.
lines.zh: 但比她的穿着更奇怪的，或许是她最近的举止。

lines.en: Now, would it be presumptuous and intensely inappropriate for me to mention that she’s getting to “that age” where parts of her may start to change based on things her body {b}CRAVES?{/b} Sure.
lines.zh: 那么，我要是提一句她已经到了「那个年纪」、身体的某些部位可能会因为身体{b}渴求{/b}的东西而开始变化，会不会太冒昧、太不合适？当然会。

lines.en: But I’m going to mention it anyway because I’m one or two more flirty sentences away from ripping that mask off of her head and shoving my cock so far down her throat that she suffocates and dies.
lines.zh: 但我还是要说，因为我再多听一两句她那种调情的话，就要把那面具从她头上扯下来，把我的鸡巴捅进她喉咙深处，深到让她窒息而死。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo11
Anyway, here are some more girls that I want to have sex with {b}AND ONE THAT I MAY ALREADY HAVE.{/b}
lines.zh: 总之，这里又有一堆我想上的人{b}其中一个我可能已经上过了{/b}。

lines.en: : Oi! If it isn’t the Supreme Overlord here to join us for another Samhain! Blessed be the day!
lines.zh: : 喂！这不是至高无上的领主大人吗，又来跟我们共度萨温节了！今日何其有幸！

lines.en: : Svarog!
lines.zh: : Svarog！

lines.en: : Bless you.
lines.zh: : 祝福你。

lines.en: : What is your costume supposed to be? Real estate agent?
lines.zh: : 你这身扮的是什么？房产中介？

lines.en: : What? No. Why would you assume that?
lines.zh: : 什么？不是。你凭什么这么猜？

lines.en: : The answer looked as if it had to be either that or “partially reformed predator” and I assumed the latter was far too specific a costume for you to wear.
lines.zh: : 答案看起来要么是那个，要么是「半个改过自新的捕食者」，而我以为后者作为装扮对你来说太过具体了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo12
: This is the same way I always dress, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 我一直都是这么穿的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : It is? Then I apologize. I try to look at you as little as possible.
lines.zh: : 是吗？那我道歉。我尽量少看你几眼。

lines.en: : Don’t pull the boss before we’ve cleared the trash mobs, Kendo Princess. Riling Sir up now will do nothing but make the rest of the night harder for the whole group.
lines.zh: : 小怪还没清完别急着开 boss，剑道公主。现在把 Sir 惹毛了，只会让全队今晚剩下的时间更难熬。

lines.en: : I apologize once more. I was told that I needed to act dominant tonight to fit my character, but I saw no better way of doing that than putting you in your proper place. Which happens to be nowhere near me.
lines.zh: : 我再次道歉。有人告诉我今晚要表现得强势一点才符合角色设定，但我想不出比让你回到你该待的位置更好的办法了。而你该待的位置，恰好是离我越远越好。

lines.en: : And to think it was just the other day you were calling me your husband and riding the ferris wheel with me.
lines.zh: : 想想就在前几天，你还叫我老公，跟我一起坐摩天轮呢。

lines.en: : That sounds unlike anything I’ve ever-
lines.zh: : 这听起来完全不像我会做过的-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo13
: Ah-
: There is no one with you tonight! You’re as free as a fly!
lines.zh: : 今晚你身边一个人都没有！你自由得像只苍蝇！

lines.en: : Well, that’s great news because I feel like there’s been a shadow crawling up my leg ever since I set foot outside my house and I was almost ready to chop it off.
lines.zh: : 哦，这可是好消息，因为自从踏出家门，我就觉得有什么影子顺着腿往上爬，我差点就要把它砍下来了。

lines.en: : Likely just a gnome, Sir. Stealthy little buggers, they are. Oddly shaped heads, though.
lines.zh: : 大概只是个地精，Sir。这些小东西鬼鬼祟祟的。不过脑袋形状挺奇怪。

lines.en: : Ferris wheel...
lines.zh: : 摩天轮……

lines.en: Tsuneyo begins to remember something, but I’m too focused on Molly’s belly button to pay any attention to that.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 似乎开始想起什么，但我太专注于 Molly 的肚脐，根本没心思管那个。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo14
I, too, begin to remember something.
lines.zh: 我也开始想起什么。

lines.en: It was a night just like tonight, but a different song was playing.
lines.zh: 那是一个和今晚一样的夜晚，只是放的是另一首歌。

lines.en: I had just won a million credits and cashed them in on a trip to BONE-TOWN with the local Irish girl.
lines.zh: 我刚赢了一百万点数，把它们兑换成了和本地那个爱尔兰女孩一起去骨镇的旅程。

lines.en: I have had many subsequent opportunities to return to BONE-TOWN with her since then, but I have yet to do so because, like I mentioned just moments ago, my brain is borken. Bokern. Broken*
lines.zh: 从那以后，我有过很多次和她重返骨镇的机会，但我一次都没去，因为就像我刚才说的，我的脑子坏掉了。坏悼了。坏掉了*

lines.en: And I can’t help but feel like something terrible is going to happen.
lines.zh: 而且我忍不住觉得，有什么可怕的事即将发生。

lines.en: But thankfully, there’s this belly button to cheer me up. And it is only a matter of time until my {b}cock{/b} is so deep inside of her that it is protruding from her stomach and attempting to get acquainted with it.
lines.zh: 但幸好还有这个肚脐能让我高兴起来。而且迟早有一天，我的{b}鸡巴{/b}会深到从她的胃里顶出来，顺便跟那个肚脐打个招呼。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo13
Wait. No. I shouldn’t think of that right now. Tsuneyo is onto something. I should talk to Tsuneyo about-
lines.zh: 等等。不。我现在不该想这个。Tsuneyo 好像发现了什么。我该跟 Tsuneyo 聊聊-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo15
N e v e r m i n d. I g u e s s I a m h e r e n o w.
lines.zh: 算 了 吧。看 来 我 已 经 到 这 儿 了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo16
: Arrrr! Pirate Chika’s here to plunder ye’ heart!
lines.zh: : 啊呜！海盗 Chika 来劫掠你的心啦！

lines.en: : And Pirate Uta’s here to watch and totally not get excited about it! Arrrrr!
lines.zh: : 海盗 Uta 在这儿负责看着，而且绝对不会为此兴奋！啊呜呜呜！

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo17
: And I am also here. Hello.
lines.zh: : 我也在。你好。

lines.en: : First off, you two need better pirate names. Second, I applaud you for dressing up two years in a row, Io. Third, what are you?
lines.zh: : 首先，你们俩得换个更好的海盗名。其次，Io，你连续两年都打扮了，我为你鼓掌。第三，你扮的是什么？

lines.en: : I work at Lawson.
lines.zh: : 我在罗森上班。

lines.en: : That’s your costume. Working at Lawson?
lines.zh: : 这就是你的装扮？在罗森上班？

lines.en: : Would you be happier if I doused myself in cheap perfume and started shouting “Arrrr” at you like that’s a thing pirates actually said?
lines.zh: : 那我要是往身上喷满廉价香水，冲你大喊「啊呜」——好像海盗真会这么说似的——你就高兴了？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo18
: Why do you always have to take the fun out of everything? You’re like some kind of human vacuum that just sucks up all the good vibes.
lines.zh: : 你为什么非要把什么事都搞得没意思？你就像某种人形吸尘器，把所有好气氛都吸走了。

lines.en: : I imagine you are also like “some kind of human vacuum.” Just I can’t say what it is that you suck up while I am on the clock, and I am very clearly at work at Lawson right now.
lines.zh: : 我想你大概也是「某种人形吸尘器」。只是我在上班时间不便说你吸的是什么，而我现在很明显是在罗森上班。

lines.en: : Io, come on. Chika’s awesome. And I’m not just saying that because she’s the newest employee at the maid cafe.
lines.zh: : Io，别这样。Chika 很棒的。而且我这么说可不是因为她成了女仆咖啡厅的新员工。

lines.en: : Is she? Is that finally a confirmed thing?
lines.zh: : 是吗？这事终于定了？

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo19
: It sure is! I got my official uniform today and thought about wearing {i}that{/i} as my costume instead, but I felt bad about leaving Uta to plunder all of the booty herself.
lines.zh: : 当然！我今天拿到了正式制服，本来想干脆穿{i}那个{/i}当万圣节装扮，但又不好意思让 Uta 一个人去掠夺所有战利品。

lines.en: : Don’t even think about saying whatever it is you’re about to say until I’m at least five miles away.
lines.zh: : 你接下来想说的那句话，最好等我至少走出五英里再想。

lines.en: : Never mind.
lines.zh: : 没事了。

lines.en: : Chika’s gonna be great. The only thing I’m really worried about is that she’s going to take all of my sales. Primarily the ones that come from you since those are...at least half of what I make on a monthly basis.
lines.zh: : Chika 会做得很棒的。我唯一担心的是她会把我的业绩全抢走。主要是来自你的那一块，因为那……至少占我月收入的一半。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo20
: Does Sensei really spend that much on you?
lines.zh: : Sensei 真的在你身上花那么多钱吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s kind of a-
lines.zh: : 嗯。算是有点-

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo21
: Uhh! I mean...no! He doesn’t spend anything on me! I mean...why would he?!
lines.zh: : 啊！我是说……不！他才没在我身上花钱！我是说……他为什么要？！

lines.en: : Why are you freaking out right now?
lines.zh: : 你慌什么啊？

lines.en: : Because...I...
scene halloweenfourmingletwo22
: Ugh...who knows?
lines.zh: : 呃……谁知道呢。

lines.en: : I have no idea what I’m even doing anymore.
lines.zh: : 我都不知道自己在做什么了。

lines.en: : Sorry, Chika. Life has just gotten way more confusing out of nowhere lately.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Chika。生活不知怎么一下子变得复杂多了。

lines.en: : Relax, Uta. Even if Sensei {i}is{/i} effectively your platonic sugar daddy, it’s just a job. Right? He’s been paying my phone bill for years. It’s probably his way of just trying to support you or something.
lines.zh: : 放轻松，Uta。就算 Sensei {i}真的{/i}相当于你的柏拉图式金主，那也只是一份工作而已。对吧？他替我交了好几年话费了。大概只是他想支持你什么的。

lines.en: Yeah, it definitely doesn’t have anything to do with the fact that I want to have so much rough sex with her that her internal organs liquefy and ooze out of her vagina.
lines.zh: 是啊，这绝对跟我想和她狠狠做到内脏化成水、从阴道里流出来这件事毫无关系。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo23
: Yeah...Yeah. You’re right. I just kind of felt like...you were about to get mad at me or something.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯。你说得对。我只是觉得……你好像要生我的气什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not going to get mad at you for doing what you have to do to support yourself. Like, trust me. I am the {i}last{/i} person who would look down on someone like that.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你为了养活自己而做的事生气。真的，相信我。我{i}最{/i}没资格看不起那样的人了。

lines.en: scene halloweenfourmingletwo24
: Plus, if {i}I{/i} were in Sensei’s shoes, I’d probably be spending all of my money on you as well. Even now, I want to just eat you up.
lines.zh: : 再说，如果{i}我{/i}是 Sensei，大概也会把钱都花在你身上。就算现在，我也只想把你吃掉。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah......hah...
: Sensei, do you have a few minutes to spare? I was wondering if you’d be able to help me kill myself.
lines.zh: : Sensei，你有几分钟空吗？我在想你能不能帮我杀了我自己。

lines.en: scene black
: We can kill each other, Io.
lines.zh: : 我们可以互相杀，Io。

lines.en: : Best news I’ve heard all year.
lines.zh: : 这是我今年听过最好的消息。

lines.en: : Ugh, can the two of you stop being so morbid? Act more like Uta. Just look at her being all...cute and obedient and stuff.
lines.zh: : 呃，你们俩能不能别这么阴森？学学 Uta。看看人家，多……可爱又听话什么的。

lines.en: : She’s literally drooling.
lines.zh: : 她真的在流口水。

lines.en: : Come here, Io. I’ll scratch you under your chin as well and we can see how {i}you{/i} like it.
lines.zh: : 过来，Io。我也给你挠挠下巴，看看{i}你{/i}喜不喜欢。

lines.en: : Sensei, why am I still alive? Why do I still breathe?
lines.zh: : Sensei，我为什么还活着？我为什么还在呼吸？

lines.en: {b}BECAUSE I NEED TO MINGLE WITH MORE GIRLS.{/b}
lines.zh: {b}因为我还要去和更多的女生交际。{/b}
